{"question":{"id":"q17","question":"苏天晴提出什么游戏，胜利条件是什么？","readAt":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":128},"group":"ordinary","category":"event","expected":"她提出玩挠痒痒；若风信子坚持一分钟不叫出声，她就放风信子下来。","certainty":"supported","evidence":[{"chapter":4,"paragraph":127,"quote":"“挠痒痒哟。”"},{"chapter":4,"paragraph":128,"quote":"“这样吧，要是风信子小姐你能坚持一分钟不叫出声，狐狐我就放你下来~”"}]},"answer":{"queries":6,"sourceQueries":6,"exhausted":true,"answer":{"text":"在已读章节4第128段处，苏天晴（自称“狐狐”）只提出想和风信子“玩点游戏”，并说胜利条件为“你赢了的话我就把你放下来”，但尚未说出具体是什么游戏。因此：游戏名称未知；胜利条件为赢下游戏即可被放下。","status":"partial","recordIds":["source-c04"],"sources":[{"chapter":4,"paragraph":121}]},"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":4,"query":"苏天晴","from":1,"to":128},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":4,"query":"游戏","from":1,"to":128},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":4,"query":"胜利","from":1,"to":128}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-4","sourceManifest":"manifest:ab921696d519ac1a","knowledgeRevision":4,"readAt":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":129},"contentHash":"2123d98d1e4add30fc01cf4b64041aa9bb8c95ccce05a21d9e21e7aa2b744de8"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":4,"paragraph":128},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c04","revision":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":41,"text":"苏天晴认真打量起正与黑狼怪人战作一团的天蓝色魔法少女。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c04","revision":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":48,"text":"苏天晴很想朝那本秘典质问一下。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c04","revision":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":50,"text":"于是苏天晴斥资50神典石巨款，买下了一瓶看起来就很带劲的【怪人强化药A】，往乖巧匍匐在自己脚边的黑狼怪人嘴里灌了进去。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c04","revision":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":55,"text":"“原来如此……”苏天晴在心中呢喃自语。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c04","revision":1,"chapter":4,"paragraph":85,"text":"“反应过来了吗，真是迟钝呢。”苏天晴轻笑着答道。"},{"type":"source"
